taylor: Quick follow-up from the RDI-4021 postmortem. We promised concrete owners for regression/eval additions (prompt-sets, CI gates, load profile, chaos drill). Can we assign and lock dates?
min: I'll author the prompt-set group for the fallback-tokenization and stop-seq cases. Goal: small JSON suite that CI can run in <30s. Will include variants that use the fallback model path.
drew: I'll take the load profile + k6 spike and schedule the dry-run with SRE. Proposed shape: baseline 200 rps, 60s spike to 800 rps, then drain 1 GPU at t+95s. I'll add abort criteria (error rate >2% or stop-seq failures >0.5%).	taylor: Great. anya, can you add the eval-harness changes (KV warmup + top-k drift metric + CI badge gate)?
anya: Yes. Plan: add KV warmup step, record top-k distributions, and fail the canary if top-k shift >5% or regression suite fails >0. CI job names: `ci-eval/regression-smoke` and `ci-eval/regression-nightly`.
min: Timeline proposal: prompt-set PR by Thu (2026-04-02), unit checks in CI by next Tue (2026-04-07). Owner: @min.
drew: Chaos drill target: Friday (2026-04-10) dry-run with SRE present, full run next week if dry-run passes. Ticket: I'll create RDI-5001.	taylor: Rotation for triage when CI fails? We should avoid ping storms. Suggested rota: eng-ml weekdays 09:00-18:00, eng-platform nights/weekends. Make a tiny rota doc.
anya: I'll implement a `regression-needs-triage` label that CI adds on failure and a short triage checklist in the repo. Also add a dashboard alert when top-k drift >5% over 30m.
min: Example minimal regression entry I'll add to suites/regression/fallback_role_tokenization.json:
```json
[{"id":"fb-001","prompt":"user: Hello
assistant:","assert":"token_role_consistency"}]
```
drew: k6 spike snippet I'll attach to the ticket:
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post(__ENV.GEN_URL, JSON.stringify({prompt: 'role:user\\ncontent: test spike'}), {headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}})
}
```
incident-bot: Created RDI-5001 (chaos drill: fallback + node drain) assigned to drew, due 2026-04-10.
taylor: Recap owners/dates: min - prompt-set + CI unit checks (due 2026-04-02 / 2026-04-07), anya - eval-harness + CI gate + alerting (due 2026-04-07), drew - chaos drill runbook + dry-run (due 2026-04-10), taylor - publish rota doc and update postmortem follow-ups (due 2026-04-03).
anya: I'll update RDI-4021 follow-ups with the ticket links once created. If CI flags a regression, the on-call should follow the triage checklist and @taylor if unclear. :white_check_mark:
